name: RSSWire
author: Thirdy

sections.description:
Important: Please do not use this plugin on multi-author/more than 50 post sites as it is in beta. Thank you.

Generates a simple RSS 2.0 rss.xml containing published posts with full post content. Admin UI to regenerate and shows file path/URL.

Simple white-label tool for your WP RSS Feed

Two ways to install:
1. Via WordPress Plugin Directory on your site
2. Via https://wordpress.org/plugins/rsswire/ then click Download

The Official Site is at https://thirdy.qzz.io/rsswire
sections.faq:
Does my WordPress blog title get auto added?

Yes, It does all the hard work for you!

Does my post get added automatically?

Yes, of course it gets added to your feed

Does it write to / directly?

No, it writes to var/www/html/wp-content/uploads/rsswire/ so it wouldn’t break on permissions.
